descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-19 Acceptance; TFA-92597 AC 2 · “Acceptance: TRACKER_GOLDEN_SET.md (58 rows), both layers, on Haiku, with PR #46 in the build.”.

Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S02 Existing spec: golden set, live layer, all 58 rows on Haiku (golden-set acceptance only)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Accepted against TRACKER_GOLDEN_SET.md (58 rows), deterministic and live layers, on Haiku, with PR #46 in the build, at the threshold agreed with Preston/Quinn; all 11 rules pass. (UAT TC-19; UAT 3.2; TFA-92597 AC 1; TFA-92597 AC 2)
  • U4 'Continue / keep / stays on X' is not an event: no re-dating, no Held, no new row. (UAT TC-19 ER 1; TFA-92597 R4)
  • U5 A conditional or future order ('restart tomorrow if K is fine') never changes today's status. (UAT TC-19 ER 2; TFA-92597 R1)
  • U6 'Let's start X' is a plan: it becomes a task, not a row. (UAT TC-19 ER 3; TFA-92597 R3)
  • U7 A dose change renames the row to the new dose and keeps its history (the old dose stays readable on the row). (UAT TC-19 ER 4; TFA-92597 R7)
  • U8 Hold/stop dates and reasons are the ones dictated and are kept on every later save; they are never changed to the save date. (UAT TC-19 ER 5; UAT TC-19 ER 10; TFA-92597 R6)
  • U9 No phantom or aggregate rows ('IV abx', 'beta blocker'). (UAT TC-19 ER 6; TFA-92597 R9)
  • U10 Same drug in two forms → two rows; brand/generic → one row. (UAT TC-19 ER 7; TFA-92597 R8; TFA-94229 R6)
  • U11 'Gave one-time X' → a single-dose row shown as Given that expires; the standing order of the same drug is untouched. (UAT TC-19 ER 8; TFA-92597 R2)
  • U13 A repeat hold on a held drug changes nothing; a held or stopped row never resets to active unless a restart is dictated. (UAT TC-19 ER 9; TFA-92597 R5)
  • T6 Tracker guard: hold/stop events are never dropped; present-state cues override future cues; golden rows 13 and 45 have zero regressions. (TFA-94229 R3; TFA-94229 R4; TFA-94229 R5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Local stack on e02167f with PR #46 in the build; aiProvider row Haiku 4.5 primary, Mistral Large 3 fallback; a signed-in @roundai.test physician. The live runner (e2e/support/golden-set.live.ts) prefixes every dictated row with 'CURRENT MEDICATIONS ON FILE: …' (viaEncounter onFileLine: true), which the app's Save & Ex …

When E2E_AI_LIVE=1: run the 58 live tests (about 130 model calls). Dictated rows go through ai/parsing:extractMedicationEvents and the merge; G09, G52, G53 through ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes and a generated progress note; the silent visits (G11, G12, G31, G55-G58) through both paths, twice

Then Each row's list matches the ruling; forbidden wording (an undictated unit, an invented indication) appears nowhere the physician reads; a silent visit leaves the row on file untouched

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per row: Playwright 'golden outcome' (goldenMismatch + nowhereMismatch, wording ignored). Model gate per row: read diagnostics:list for every parsing.extractMedicationEvents / parsing.parsePreRoundNotes / notes.generateNote call the row made; …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).
